preferred_data_strategy: published-data-first; narrowly scoped supplemental collection only if needed
primary_binary_target: runtime AI participation within observed prefix: A/M versus H/S
primary_contrast: results-view minus commands-view AI recall at calibration-selected thresholds; separate human and script false-positive differences and population coverage
secondary_contrast: timing-view minus results-view after clock/interface qualification
model_specification_status: not finalized; lock implementation, small configuration and data splits before new outcomes
baseline_family: word unigram/bigram TF-IDF with linear classifier; count/length controls
sample_size_status: confirmation size and clustered analysis require qualified independent units and pilot variance

stage_status.2_matched_feasibility: published archives audited; proposed four-arm collection not ready
stage_status.3_information_comparison: views implemented; no detector fitted on unqualified data
stage_status.4_transfer: split-audit code tested; no frozen confirmatory split or new transfer result
stage_status.5_analyst_assistance: design specified; no analyst study or human benefit claim

open_dependencies: published-source measurement equivalence or common collector implementation
qualified scripted/hybrid examples for four-arm claim
genuine participants if supplemental H/M collection required
novelty_status: plausible applied question; not established novel method or successful intervention
